answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in wander, verified in zephyr, and jade names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 21 submissions per epoch. That bill is paid per identity, so 217 aliases cost 305 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
